PORT.description: HTTP listen port. Calnode defaults to 3000; Railway maps the public domain to this port.

BASE_URL.description: Public identity host (e.g. https://book.example.com or https://<your-domain>.up.railway.app after deploy). Drives OAuth callbacks, the admin UI, and team-invite links. Set your real domain after the first deploy and redeploy — OAuth redirect URIs are computed from this value.

DATABASE_URL.description: SQLite driver pointing at the Railway volume mount. SQLite is the only store (pure-Go, no CGO, no Postgres). Keep this path — the directory is on the calnode-data volume.

CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Envelope-encryption master key; auto-generated per deployment. REQUIRED for production (https BASE_URL). Rotatable later with `calnode rotate-key`.

CALNODE_RECOVERY_SECRET.description: Optional break-glass escrow. When set, a recovery-wrapped copy of the data key is stored so you can re-establish access with `calnode recover-key` if CALNODE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is ever lost.

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Optional booker-facing host for public booking links and outbound emails. Blank = inherits BASE_URL. Only set if your booking pages live on a different host than admin.

TZ.description: Timezone for meeting times, reminders, log timestamps. Set to you, e.g. America/New_York.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional — Google OAuth client ID (console.cloud.google.com). Add redirect URIs: {BASE_URL}/v1/auth/callback and {BASE_URL}/v1/calendar/callback.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional — Google OAuth client secret (pair with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional — Microsoft 365 / Outlook client ID (Azure App registration). Web redirect URIs: {BASE_URL}/v1/auth/microsoft/callback and {BASE_URL}/v1/calendar/callback.

MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional — Microsoft client secret (pair with MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID).

MICROSOFT_TENANT.description: Microsoft tenant. Default 'common' allows personal + work/school Microsoft accounts. Set to a specific tenant ID to restrict to one organisation.

EMAIL_SMTP_HOST.description: Optional — SMTP host for booking invitation / confirmation / reminder emails. Blank = emails are skipped (app still works; users get links in the UI).

EMAIL_FROM_ADDRESS.description: Optional — From address for booking emails, e.g. bookings@yourdomain.com.

EMAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Optional — Display name for booking email sender.

LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL.description: Optional — S3-compatible bucket for continuous SQLite backups (Litestream) and meeting recordings. e.g. s3://your-bucket/calnode. Blank = no remote backups; the calnode-data volume still holds the primary DB.

LITESTREAM_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Optional — S3 access key for Litestream uploads (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

LITESTREAM_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Optional — S3 secret key for Litestream uploads (pair with LITESTREAM_REPLICA_URL).

LITESTREAM_ENDPOINT.description: Optional — S3 endpoint host. Required for any non-AWS provider (R2, B2, MinIO). Blank = AWS us-east-1.

LITESTREAM_REGION.description: Optional — S3 region (required by some providers, optional by others).
